evidence.reason: The dependency scan follows a symlink with path.stat(), then at lines 695-696 silently continues for any non-regular target, including a symlinked drop-in directory. The surrounding comment preserves a no-follow policy for directory traversal, but systemd can traverse a symlinked drop-in directory such as backup.service.d and read dependencies from it. Since the scanner neither reads that directory nor records the traversal as an incomplete observation, discovery can incorrectly report complete/supported while missing a dependency. The smallest compatible repair is to keep the no-follow policy but mark the observation incomplete when an unscanned symlinked drop-in directory could be traversed by systemd.
